purpose:
**LAYERS Index**

This index tracks all layer definition files under the top-level LAYERS/ folder. The mirror logic / index_builder.py should auto-populate this when new layers are added. Each layer .md file defines its own UI rules, routing logic, and notes.
notes: Self-discovering: index_builder.py scans LAYERS/ for subfolders containing {name}.md and auto-adds them. Default layer = boot. Fallback on missing = /dev.
